about.title: What is Knowledge Kareem?
about.body: Every one of us holds knowledge worth sharing. It might be an experience, a skill, or a lesson you picked up along the way. That’s where Knowledge Kareem comes in: a space where employees across the group exchange their expertise through short, varied sessions and workshops — to strengthen learning, trade best practices, and make the most of the experience already among us.

platform.title: The platform is live
platform.body: Knowledge Kareem is not a plan for later. The platform brings sessions, attendance, discussion and recognition together in one place, and you sign in with your work account at any of our companies.
platform.feature1Title: Browse sessions and book a seat
platform.feature1Body: Short sessions and workshops led by colleagues, with their times and rooms — your seat is one tap away.
platform.feature2Body: A short code appears in the session; enter it on your phone and your attendance is recorded.
platform.feature3Body: Ask questions, open the session's materials, and rate it once it ends.
platform.feature4Body: Every session you attend or lead adds to your balance, and your certificate carries a code that proves it.
platform.signInHint: With your work account at any of our companies

provider.title: Share your knowledge
provider.step1Body: Tell us your proposed topic in a minute
provider.step2Body: The initiative team reaches out and helps you shape your session
provider.step3Body: Deliver your session and leave an impact that outlasts it

attendee.title: Learn from your colleagues
attendee.step1Body: Browse upcoming sessions on the platform
attendee.step2Body: Book your seat in the sessions that interest you
attendee.step3Body: Learn, join the discussion, and earn points

recognition.title: Build your name — not just your points
recognition.body: Every session you give or attend earns you points — and adds to your company’s standing across the group. But what matters more: your name becomes tied to the knowledge you shared, and your impact stays with your colleagues. At the end of the year, we celebrate our most generous contributors.

policy.title: You don’t need to be an expert
policy.intro: The best sessions aren’t academic lectures — they’re real experiences. Any one of these is enough:
policy.card1Body: A tangible result you achieved at work that others can repeat
policy.card2Body: Something you used yourself, with what worked and what didn’t
policy.card3Title: A lesson that changed your thinking
policy.card3Body: An experience or mistake that changed how you work
policy.closer: If you have one of these, you have a session.

finalCta.title: Be among the first to share — and the first to know
finalCta.body: Register your interest in leading or attending a session, and the initiative team will be in touch. Already have an account? Sign in to the platform now.
